title: 第4章 得饶人处且饶人
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
就在天一准备动手之际，一道白色身影自云端降落，打断了她的动作。

    “小友，你何必这么咄咄逼人呢？”

    “得饶人处且饶人，也免得日后惹了祸端，你背后之人保不住你。”

    来人白衣黑发，一派端庄严肃的模样，一开口就是说教，微生璃月甚至都不用猜，就知道面前的人是太虚宗掌门慕鹤云，化神期巅峰修士，原著中男主的师父。

    她带的这几个人可干不过面前这位，不过面上还得装下去，自己现在的人设可是不可一世的高傲大小姐，谁来都看不上。

    怕掌门？这不符合人设。

    而且统子说了，她现在身上这一身天阶法宝，大乘期以下完全不用虚，使劲造就行。

    实在打不过，她新手包里还有八品瞬移符，跑就是了。

    有了底气，微生璃月轻蔑道：“保不住我？对方是渡劫还是仙人，有几条命够杀的？”

    “而且别人骂我，还要我绕过他，我又不是什么善良的人。”

    道德绑架什么的，对微生璃月没用，她的心早在那几年的牛马生活里被磨的生硬。

    “天一，动手。”微生璃月无视慕鹤云的存在，继续下达指令。

    眼看着少女身后的人真要动手，慕鹤云脸上忍不住抽了抽，做太虚宗掌门这么多年，他已经很久没见过有人敢在他面前这么嚣张了。

    还有她的话是什么意思？渡劫还是仙人，她背后的底气这么足吗？

    连渡劫期大能都不怕，也不怕说大话闪了舌头。

    慕鹤云在内心腹诽着，现实里仍是出手阻止了天一的动作，叶不凡是极品变异雷灵根，不能让他陨落在这。

    然而下一刻，慕鹤云愣住了……

    一股超越化神期的威压从少女身后的青衣女侍身上传来，直将他压得脊背弓起，浑身被冷汗浸湿，这个女侍是合体期？

    实际上，微生璃月刚刚花费300装逼值兑换了个合体中期修士的威压，并用在了天一身上，效果只有一刻钟。

    要是过了这个时间再探，天一依旧是元婴期巅峰的水平。
content_en:
Just when Tianyi was about to take action, a white figure landed from the clouds, interrupting her movements.

"Little friend, why are you so aggressive?"

"Be merciful and merciful, so as not to cause trouble in the future. The people behind you can't protect you."

The man with white clothes and black hair had a dignified and solemn look. He started to preach. Weisheng Liyue didn't even have to guess. She knew that the person in front of her was Mu Heyun, the head of the Taixu Sect, a peak monk in the Transformation Stage and the master of the male protagonist in the original work.

The few people she brought could not defeat the person in front of her, but she still had to put on a good show. Her current persona was that of an arrogant young lady who no one could look down upon.

Afraid of the leader?This doesn't fit the character.

Moreover, Tongzi said that the heaven-level magic weapon she now possesses does not need to be used up at all after the Mahayana stage, just work hard to cultivate it.

If you really can't beat her, she still has an eighth-grade teleportation talisman in her newbie bag, so just run away.

With confidence, Weisheng Liyue said contemptuously: "Can't you protect me? Is the opponent a tribulation or an immortal? How many lives can he kill?"

"And when people scold me and ask me to go around them, I'm not a kind person."

Moral kidnapping is of no use to Wei Sheng Liyue. Her heart has been hardened during those years of living as a cow and horse.

"Tianyi, do it." Weisheng Liyue ignored Mu Heyun's presence and continued to issue instructions.

Seeing that the person behind the girl was really about to take action, Mu Heyun couldn't help but twitch on his face. He had been the head of Taixu Sect for so many years, and it had been a long time since he had seen someone dare to be so arrogant in front of him.

And what did she mean?She is still an immortal after overcoming the tribulation. Does she have such confidence behind her?

He is not even afraid of being a powerful person in the Tribulation Stage, nor is he afraid of speaking nonsense.

Mu Heyun cursed in his heart. In reality, he still stopped Tianyi's actions. Ye Bufan had the best mutated thunder root and could not let him die here.

However, the next moment, Mu Heyun was stunned...

A coercion beyond the God Transformation stage came from the green-robed maid behind the girl, which pressed him so hard that his back arched and his whole body was soaked in cold sweat. Is this maid in the Fusion stage?

In fact, Weisheng Liyue had just spent 300 pretense points to exchange for the pressure of a mid-integration monk, and used it on Tianyi, and the effect only lasted for a quarter of an hour.

If we check again after this time, Tianyi is still at the peak of the Nascent Soul stage.
title_en: Chapter 4: Give mercy to others when you have to
